definitions.gloss: brush cutter; string trimmer; weed whacker
definitions.explanation: A handheld powered tool with a rotating blade or nylon cord on a long shaft, used to cut grass and undergrowth. It is the technical name found in manuals, safety rules, and rental listings.

examples.japanese: {刈|か}り{払|はら}い{機|き}を{借|か}りた。
{刈|か}り{払|はら}い{機|き}を{使|つか}うときは{保護|ほご}メガネをつける。
examples.english: Wear safety goggles when using a brush cutter.

examples.japanese: {刈|か}り{払|はら}い{機|き}の{刃|は}が{石|いし}に{当|あ}たると{危|あぶ}ないので、{足元|あしもと}をよく{確認|かくにん}すること。
examples.english: It is dangerous if the brush cutter's blade hits a stone, so check the ground carefully.

notes:
{刈|か}り{払|はら}う (to cut down and clear away) + {機|き} (machine). Written {刈払機|かりはらいき} without okurigana in technical documents and product names.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {刈|か}り{払|はら}い{機|き}を{使|つか}う: to use a brush cutter
- {刈|か}り{払|はら}い{機|き}の{刃|は}: the blade of a brush cutter
- {刈|か}り{払|はら}い{機|き}の{取扱|とりあつか}い{講習|こうしゅう}: brush cutter handling course

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {草刈|くさか}り{機|き}: grass cutter — the everyday word for the same tool; {刈|か}り{払|はら}い{機|き} is the term used in manuals and safety regulations
- {芝刈|しばか}り{機|き}: lawn mower — a wheeled machine for lawns, not a handheld one
